text:
🧡 My First Acupuncture + Cupping Therapy Experience 🧡
I came in with shoulder and neck pain from working on the computer and using my phone a lot for work, causing stiffness in my shoulders and pain radiating to the back of my neck.
‼️ Acupuncture Procedure ‼️ It wasn't scary or painful at all. You'll feel a slight sensation when the doctor inserts the needles, but it's not painful at all!
⚡️Electrical Stimulation for Muscle Relaxation⚡️
‘It was amazing!’ The muscle twitching lasted 20 minutes. During the treatment, I felt rhythmic twitching. ⚠️(Don't worry about electric shock. The doctor uses a low energy level. If you feel too much twitching, you can ask the doctor to reduce the energy level.)⚠️
🔮 Cupping Therapy 🔮 I felt a slight tightness on my skin when the cups were placed. Because the cups create a vacuum, they suck the skin in, stimulating blood circulation and helping to relax muscles. The cups were left on for 8-10 minutes. (If you feel the cups are too tight and causing pain, you can ask them to loosen them slightly.) The feeling while the cups were on was amazing, like my soul was being sucked out!🤣 It was incredibly relaxing. And when the cups were removed, it felt like the ultimate bliss! I feel my muscles are relaxed, and the hard lumps in my shoulders have softened a lot.
❓Compared to massage❓ I feel that acupuncture and cupping are much better at solving the problem. Sometimes when I get a shoulder massage, it's very stiff, and the masseuse massages too hard, which can cause more muscle inflammation and shoulder pain.
Overall, it's very good. The clinic responds to messages quickly. There's only one doctor in the clinic, but they do things very quickly. The doctor speaks well, but a little too fast (I couldn't quite understand)🤣
📌 Most importantly, the doctor is handsome📌 Let's get acupuncture ❤️
